LESSON: THE INSPIRED WORD OF GOD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Holy Bible
Topic 2.1: The Inspired Word of God

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The Inspired Word of God
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should you respect the Holy Bible?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the books in the Old and New Testament
2. role play naming some books in the Bible
3. recite Isaiah 49:16 and desire to read the Holy Bible always

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify the books in the Old and New Testament
• Model 2: role play naming some books in the Bible
• Model 3: recite Isaiah 49:16 and desire to read the Holy Bible always

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify the books in the Old and New Testament
2. Practise: role play naming some books in the Bible
3. Practise: recite Isaiah 49:16 and desire to read the Holy Bible always

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for The Inspired Word of God.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you respect the Holy Bible?
2. Why is it important to know the books in the Holy Bible?
